messages.subject: AKDE calculation
parts:
Hi!

I'm trying to run the AKDE home range estimation after model fitting, but R is taking an unusually long time to compute it, and then it stops responding. I observed a long gap in sampling in the variogram. Could this be the issue? Attaching the image for reference

Thanks in advance,
Vibhuti

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: AKDE calculation
parts:
HI Vibhuti,

Computation time should be linear in the amount of data and gaps shouldn't matter. How much data are you analyzing and did you turn trace on to see what progress is being made? If there is a remaining issue, then you can send me a minimal working example with data and script and I can look into it.

Best,
Chris
